blocks.text: Isaiah 33 contains 24 verses. It opens with: Woe to thee that destroyest, and thou wast not destroyed; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! When thou hast ceased to destroy, thou shalt be destroyed; and when thou hast made an end of dealing treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee. It concludes with: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
